name: rtl-email
description: Send email in right-to-left scripts (Hebrew, Arabic, Farsi, Urdu) that actually renders right-to-left. Plain-text email carries no direction metadata, so RTL bodies render LTR in many clients and multi-part numbers reorder. Ships dir=rtl HTML templates, separate personal and business send skills that inherit the user's saved signature profiles, and a one-time signature setup skill. Sends via Google Workspace MCP or Resend.
